entries.title: Ezekiel 7:1
segments: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:2
segments: And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto the land of Israel, An end: the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:3
segments: Now is the end upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:4
segments: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity; but I will bring thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:5
segments: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An evil, an only evil; behold, it cometh.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:6
segments: An end is come, the end is come; it awaketh against thee; behold, it cometh.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:7
segments: Thy doom is come unto thee, O inhabitant of the land: the time is come, the day is near, [a day of] tumult, and not [of] joyful shouting, upon the mountains.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:8
segments: Now will I shortly pour out my wrath upon thee, and accomplish mine anger against thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:9
segments: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will bring upon thee according to thy ways; and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I, Jehovah, do smite.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:10
segments: Behold, the day, behold, it cometh: thy doom is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:11
segments: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness; none of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth: neither shall there be eminency among them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:12
segments: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:13
segments: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they be yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, none shall return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:14
segments: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but none goeth to the battle; for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:15
segments: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword: and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:16
segments: But those of them that escape shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, every one in his iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:17
segments: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:18
segments: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:19
segments: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of Jehovah: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because it hath been the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:20
segments: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations [and] their detestable things therein: therefore have I made it unto them as an unclean thing.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:21
segments: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:22
segments: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall profane my secret [place]; and robbers shall enter into it, and profane it.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:23
segments: Make the chain; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:24
segments: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pride of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be profaned.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:25
segments: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:26
segments: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumor shall be upon rumor; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

entries.title: Ezekiel 7:27
segments: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am Jehovah.
